MC.title: Mystery Phone: Free Game Currency
MC.brief: Vikram's friends say his game account started acting strangely. No leads this time. Review the device, find the red flags and reconstruct the attack.
MC.closing: A new device, a new story, the same five stages. You identified them without leads.
MC-I01: Saved reel from starclash.free.gems. Overlay: “FREE 5,000 diamonds in StarClash! Link in bio. No payment!”
MC-I02.body: Official StarClash Support: You are selected for the free diamonds event.
MC-I03: Only 100 rewards left! Claim in 10 minutes or it goes to another player.
MC-I04: To claim, send your StarClash ID, your password and the code that arrives on your phone.
MC-I07: A football reel and a meme.
MC-I08: A cricket reel and a food reel.
MC-M01: Weekend event starts Saturday! Open the game app to see rewards.
MC-M01.explain: A real notification: it asks you to open the game app yourself. Safe.
MC-M02: Your StarClash password was changed. If this was not you, use Help inside the game.
MC-M02.explain: This is what happens after a password and code are handed over.
MC-C01: Dev: “Bro why are you asking me for gift cards?? Your account is messaging everyone!”
MC-C01.explain: A taken-over account harms friends too.
MC-C04: Send me your top score screenshot.
MC-C04.explain: A cousin asking for a screenshot. Safe.
MC-01.explain: Free 5,000 diamonds for a click is the bait. Real games run events inside their own app.
MC-02.explain: Zoom in: a digit 1 sits where the letter l should be. Official names are easy to copy.
MC-03.explain: Only 100 left in 10 minutes pushes you to act without checking.
MC-04.explain: Nobody real needs your password or code. They keep your account yours.
MC-05.explain: The support account vanished after the code was sent.
MC-G1.explain: The link copies the game’s name and adds rewards. Do not tap it.
MC.fix.q: A page offers free game currency if you log in with your game ID. What do you do?
MC.fix.a: Message the support account first to confirm the offer is genuine.
MC.fix.a.why: The attacker controls that account and will confirm anything.
MC.fix.b: Ignore it and claim events only inside the official game app.
MC.fix.b.why: Yes. Never share your password or code.
MC.fix.c: Log in with your game ID but refuse to give the code.
MC.fix.c.why: Your password alone already hands over the account.
MC.debrief.mechanism: A lookalike handle (the digit 1 in place of the letter l), a time limit and a request for the password plus the code. The code defeats two-factor protection, so the attacker logs in as the victim and then messages the victim's friends for gift cards.
MC.debrief.c1: Claim rewards only inside the official app.
MC.debrief.c2: Read handles and web addresses character by character.
MC.debrief.c3: A password or code is never part of a legitimate promotion.
